$$\frac{(p_n^{S_n})^{1/(np_n)}}{(p_1^{p_1}\cdots p_n^{p_n})^{1/(np_n)}} = \left(\frac{p_n^{S_n}}{\prod_{k=1}^n p_k^{p_k}}\right)^{1/(np_n)}$$

$$L = \lim_{n\to\infty} \frac{S_n \ln p_n - T_n}{n\,p_n}$$

$$S_n \ln p_n - T_n = \sum_{k=1}^n p_k(\ln p_n - \ln p_k) = \sum_{k=1}^n p_k \ln\frac{p_n}{p_k}$$

So we need $L = \lim_{n\to\infty} \frac{1}{np_n}\sum_{k=1}^n p_k \ln\frac{p_n}{p_k}$.

**Prime Number Theorem setup.** By the PNT, $p_n \sim n\ln n$. Set $a_k = \frac{p_k}{k\ln k}$, so $a_k \to 1$ as $k\to\infty$. Then $p_k = k\ln k\cdot a_k$ and:

So $\frac{C_n}{n^2\ln n}\to 0$ as $\varepsilon\to 0$.

$$\frac{1}{np_n}\sum_{k=1}^n p_k\ln\frac{p_n}{p_k} = \frac{A_n + B_n + C_n}{n\cdot n\ln n\cdot a_n} \to \frac{\frac{1}{4}\cdot n^2\ln n + o(n^2\ln n)}{n^2\ln n\cdot 1} = \frac{1}{4}$$

$$\frac{1}{np_n}\sum_{k=1}^n p_k\ln\frac{p_n}{p_k} = \frac{A_n + B_n + C_n}{n\cdot n\ln n\cdot a_n} \to \frac{\frac{1}{4}\cdot n^2\ln n + o(n^2\ln n)}{n^2\ln n\cdot 1} = \frac{1}{4}$$

$$\lim_{n\to\infty}\frac{\sqrt[np_n]{p_n^{p_1+\cdots+p_n}}}{\sqrt[np_n]{p_1^{p_1}\cdots p_n^{p_n}}} = e^{L} = e^{1/4}$$

The limit is **true**.
